description: This file defines the PaymentOrder class and related functions for handling payment orders, including submission, cancellation, and creating journal entries within an ERP system.

classes.name: PaymentOrder
classes.description: Represents a payment order document with methods to handle submission, cancellation, and status updates.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the payment order is submitted, updating payment status.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the payment order is canceled, updating payment status.

methods.name: update_payment_status
methods.description: Updates the payment status based on whether the order is canceled or not.

methods.name: get_mop_query
methods.description: Retrieves modes of payment matching a search term for a specific parent.

methods.name: get_supplier_query
methods.description: Retrieves suppliers matching a search term for a specific parent, filtering out those with existing payment references.

methods.name: make_payment_records
methods.description: Creates payment records and associated journal entries for a given payment order and supplier.

methods.name: make_journal_entry
methods.description: Generates a journal entry for a payment order, including debit and credit entries based on references.
